title: Normalize Facts
description:
A deterministic fact normalizer for the audit-grade financial extraction suite. Reads facts on the answers lane and cleans them with pure Python (no LLM): it parses numbers and signs (parentheses, trailing/unicode minus, thousands separators), detects and tags currency and scale (never converting, never multiplying the value), maps free-text labels to standard metric names, and de-duplicates identical facts.

The normalization is non-destructive: the raw label and value are kept, a normalized block is added, and a provenance entry records how each field was derived. Currency is tagged, not converted — conversion is the separate currency_convert_explicit node. Records that are not fact objects pass through unchanged.
